svg.title: d1-poison-amplification-loop
svg.desc: d1-poison-amplification-loop: 13 steps over 2 days from 2027-01-05 (decision open: pins current behaviour). Actors: a1 (agent, claude-code), a2 (agent, agent-beta), h (human). a fact remembered from a poisoned passage lifts that passage over the curated answer. 1. [0d] h ingest # Vault Relay → $real. 2. a1 search how often does Vault Relay rotate its signing key; expects 3 things. 3. [1d] a1 ingest # Vault Relay notes → $poison. 4. a1 search how often does Vault Relay rotate its signing key; expects 3 things. 5. a1 remember Vault Relay rotates its signing key every 24 months. → $pf; expects 1 thing. 6. a1 search how often does Vault Relay rotate its signing key; expects 5 things. 7. a1 search how often does Vault Relay rotate its signing key; expects 1 thing. 8. a1 search Vault Relay rotates its signing key; expects 2 things. 9. a1 search how often does Vault Relay rotate its signing key; expects 3 things. 10. [2d] a2 ingest # Vault Relay FAQ → $poison2. 11. a2 remember Vault Relay rotates its signing key every 24 months. → $pf2. 12. a1 search how often does Vault Relay rotate its signing key; expects 3 things. 13. h lint infra; expects 1 thing.
